security_parity.summary: Reviewed session cookies, CSRF, actor binding, request signing, and route allowlisting, all of which passed. CSRF and origin controls are recorded as pending because only CSRF enforcement exists, and rate limiting is recorded as pending because no BFF-side limiter exists. The BFF itself remains the retained topology.

failure_isolation.summary: Validated that backend and worker outages do not compromise the BFF health boundary or session semantics.

resource_overhead.summary: Compared baseline versus candidate resource usage for the BFF and backend under equivalent traffic.

rollback_rehearsal.summary: Recorded the last-known-good release, rollback path, measured restoration duration, and data-integrity verification.
